'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Rafah aid distribution killings]]
***At least 31 [[Palestinians]] are killed by the [[Israel Defense Forces]] at an aid distribution site in central [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/6/11/live-israel-kills-dozens-of-palestinian-aid-seekers-in-central-gaza?update=3767803 (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Gaza war hostage crisis]]
***[[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli forces]] in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] recover the bodies of two hostages abducted by Palestinian militants during the [[October 7 attacks]]. [https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/2025-06-11/ty-article/.premium/body-of-israeli-hostage-yair-yaakov-kidnapped-on-oct-7-recovered-from-gaza/00000197-604c-d34b-ad97-f06d34820000 (''Haaretz'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cm263j1g2rmo (BBC News)]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***The [[Gaza Health Ministry]] reports that the official death toll of [[Palestinians]] killed in the war since October 2023 has reached 55,000 people, with over 127,000 people wounded. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-news-hostages-aid-06-11-2025-5c84e29a249b988e1172cfcf4528cdc8 (AP)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Kharkiv strikes (2022–present)|Kharkiv strikes]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russia]] launches [[drone attack]]s on [[Kharkiv]], [[Ukraine]], damaging buildings and public facilities, killing three people and injuring 60 others. [https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2025/06/11/7516601/ (''Ukrainska Pravda'')] 

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[President of Argentina|Argentine president]] [[Javier Milei]] is awarded the [[Genesis Prize]] during a [[state visit]] to [[Israel]] for his support for Israel, becoming the first non-[[Jews|Jewish]] person to receive such recognition. [https://www.clarin.com/politica/javier-milei-medidas-vivo-presidente-recibe-premio-nobel-judio-gira-israel_0_ivOw2nFlgR.html (''Clarín'')] [https://www.haaretz.com/jewish/2025-06-09/ty-article/.premium/unequivocal-support-for-israel-javier-milei-will-be-first-non-jew-to-win-jewish-nobel/00000197-54ad-d586-a3f7-fdaf6ffa0000 (''Haaretz'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Australia]]n [[flag carrier]] [[Qantas]] announces the closure of its [[Singapore]]-based, partly owned [[low-cost airline]] [[Jetstar Asia]] due to rising costs and regional competition. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c1e65yypd87o (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Mediterranean Sea migrant smuggling]]
**At least eight migrants are found dead and 22 others are missing as the [[United Nations]] [[International Organization for Migration]] and the [[government of Djibouti|Djiboutian government]] launch a joint rescue operation after migrants were forced off a boat and forced to swim to shore off the coast of [[Djibouti]]. [https://apnews.com/article/djibouti-migrants-iom-4af3f64540ad829998025ee6880f3419 (AP)]
*At least 49 people are killed, including four [[schoolchildren]], in [[flood]]ing caused by heavy rainfall and snowfall in a [[winter storm]] in the [[Eastern Cape]] of [[South Africa]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/south-africa-winter-storm-leaves-over-40-dead/a-72876851 (DW)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ckgqwg9gej7o (BBC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[2025 New York Peace Conference on Gaza]]
***The [[Second presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]] calls on countries not to attend a conference for [[January 2025 Gaza war ceasefire|ceasefire and peace in Gaza]] at the [[United Nations headquarters]] in [[New York City]], [[New York (state)|New York]], [[United States]], and warns of potential diplomatic consequences should any measures be taken that are deemed hostile toward Israel. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/us-warns-against-attending-un-conference-israel-palestinian-two-state-solution-2025-06-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[Argentina–Israel relations]]
**[[President of Argentina|Argentine president]] [[Javier Milei]] announces that the Argentine embassy in [[Israel]] will be moved to [[Jerusalem]] in 2026. [https://www.ynetnews.com/article/skylvepmxx (YNet)]
*[[North Korea–South Korea relations]]
**The [[military of South Korea|military]] of [[South Korea]] shuts down its loudspeakers across the border with [[North Korea]] and stops its propaganda messages against the [[Government of North Korea|government]] of [[North Korea]] by order of [[President of South Korea|President]] [[Lee Jae-myung]] to ease tensions between the countries. [https://apnews.com/article/south-korea-border-north-tensions-2ba545996b3daf1a9f81e23685792c11 (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Opposition to Vladimir Putin in Russia]]
**A court in [[Moscow]], [[Russia]], sentences [[Leonid Volkov (politician)|Leonid Volkov]], an ally of [[Alexei Navalny]], to 18 years in prison ''[[trial in absentia|in absentia]]'' and fines him 2 million [[Russian ruble|ruble]]s (US$25,000) on criminal charges including justifying [[terrorism]] and organizing and financing an [[extremism|extremist group]]. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-courts-opposition-dissent-crackdown-ed6d394e8f1c8b6717bf1c07fa45d2e2 (AP)]
**The same court places [[Lev Shlosberg]], chair of the opposition [[social liberalism|social-liberal]] party [[Yabloko]], under [[house arrest]] for two months for discrediting the [[Russian army]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/russian-court-orders-house-arrest-politician-accused-discrediting-russian-army-2025-06-11/ (Reuters)]
